name: Seeing
overview: Scripture reveals that true seeing involves both physical and spiritual dimensions, as God Himself made the eyes and ears of man (Proverbs 20:12). While Jacob experienced the profound encounter of seeing God face to face and having his life preserved (Genesis 32:30), God also declares that no one can see His face and live (Exodus 33:20), highlighting the holiness of God contrasted with human frailty. The pure in heart are promised the blessing of seeing God (Matthew 5:8), and the psalmist's plea to have his eyes opened to behold wondrous things in God's law (Psalm 119:18) underscores the need for divine revelation to truly perceive spiritual truth. This study will explore the challenges of not seeing the truth, the reality of spiritual visions, and the call to see ourselves rightly before God.
